withdrawn_reason: These bytes are unrecoverable. The pinned URL is a mutable alias the producer overwrites in place; the bucket keeps a single S3 version and exposes no dated object, and the immutable copy was absent from the object store. Kept as the record of what was accepted on 1 August 2026, never as an importable release: require_reproducible refuses it, since the URL carries no date and no archived copy is named. Superseded by DS-02@2026-09-05. See BUG-05.
